title: Booktok Event
seo_title: BookTok Night at Amelia's Chapter House in Joplin, MO
description: Amelia's Chapter House hosts a BookTok night where you can browse books and play Book Plinko, aimed at romance readers, fantasy fans and anyone with a full TBR. A $20 ticket is required and includes $10 in book credit, one Book Plinko play, 50% off used books and 10% off new books, with only 25 tickets available. It takes place December 11, 2026, Time TBD, at 5357 N Main St in Joplin, MO.
